name: Jirani Intelligence
summary: An investigation desk that turns one urban-planning question into a structured brief. It routes the question, retrieves records from sources registered in Zetaris, and asks Meterless Nightshift to reason only over those records.
target_users: Urban planners and municipal analysts whose records sit in separately registered sources.

metadata_schema.source: Section 06 of the official Open Agent Hackathon 2026 rules requires a repository and README (6.3) and a clear explanation of the Zetaris and Meterless integrations, Cursor use, and any NVIDIA contribution (6.4). The rules do not publish a metadata.json schema. This file is the machine-readable copy of that explanation.

flow: The user submits one investigation question.
Scout Intent issues a signed execution contract that names the allowed tools.
Zetaris retrieves records from registered data sources.
Meterless Nightshift reasons over those records.
The desk returns findings, supporting records, uncertainty, evidence gaps, and next steps.

zetaris.role: Zetaris is the data access and query layer that retrieves records from registered data sources for the agent.

meterless_nightshift.what_it_does: Nightshift is the OpenAI-compatible AI provider at METERLESS_BASE_URL. The reasoning step calls POST /v1/chat/completions with model meterless/auto and may accept only findings that cite retrieved record ids.

meterless_engine.name: Scout Intent
meterless_engine.what_it_does: Scout Intent is the Meterless engine that runs before any action. It classifies the planning intent with a deterministic trigger scan, guards the prompt, routes to Zetaris and Nightshift tools, and signs an HMAC execution contract. The workflow refuses unsigned, tampered, or expired contracts.
meterless_engine.implemented_scope: In-process Stage-1 pipeline for a two-intent planning registry. Stage-2 semantic scoring is not implemented. The upstream Scout eval harness has not been run.

nvidia.reason: Rule 5.2 asks teams to integrate NVIDIA where it contributes. This 8 GB Mac path has no verified Nemotron or other NVIDIA workload, so none was added.

cursor.how: The repository, investigation workflow, adapters, tests, and Streamlit dashboard were written in Cursor during the build window.
